UC-GYM-001.name: Create New Club
UC-GYM-001.description: Create a complete new club record with validated leadership and faculty-councillor assignments.
UC-GYM-001.trigger: Student Admin chooses to create a new Gymkhana club.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Required student and faculty identity records are available.

main_success_flow.text: Student Admin enters the club name and description.
Student Admin selects an allowed club category.
Student Admin selects the coordinator and co-coordinator.
Student Admin selects the Club Faculty Councillor.
The system validates both student leaders and the faculty councillor.
The system creates the club with status open.
The system confirms successful creation.

alternative_flows.text: If any selected leader/faculty record is invalid, the system identifies the invalid assignment and allows correction without creating the club.

exception_flows.text: If required data cannot be stored, the club is not created and the system reports failure.

UC-GYM-001.success_postcondition: A new club exists with open status.
UC-GYM-001.failure_minimal_guarantee: No partial club record is treated as a successfully created club.
UC-GYM-001.notes: Student Admin replaces the previous Academic Staff/Dean actor.
UC-GYM-001.flow_label_note: ALT-n / EXC-n labels are assigned in order for referencing; they are not source IDs.

UC-GYM-002.name: Book Club Session
UC-GYM-002.description: Book a club session in a configured venue without creating a scheduling conflict.
UC-GYM-002.trigger: Club Head initiates a session booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator/co-coordinator.

main_success_flow.text: The system identifies the actor's club.
Club Head selects a configured venue and date.
Club Head enters start time, end time, description, and optionally a poster.
The system validates the time range.
The system checks the requested slot against all existing sessions and events for the same venue/date.
The system creates the session when no conflict exists.
The system notifies the intended student recipients.
The system confirms the booking.

alternative_flows.text: If the slot overlaps an existing session or event, the system rejects the booking and asks the actor to select another slot.

exception_flows.text: If the venue is invalid, the time range is invalid, or storage/notification processing fails before acceptance, no successful booking is recorded.

UC-GYM-002.success_postcondition: Session is stored and student notification is initiated.
UC-GYM-002.failure_minimal_guarantee: No conflicting or invalid session is accepted.
UC-GYM-002.notes: Cross-type conflict checking is required even if the prior implementation checked session and event collections separately.
UC-GYM-002.flow_label_note: ALT-n / EXC-n labels are assigned in order for referencing; they are not source IDs.

UC-GYM-003.name: Book Club Event
UC-GYM-003.description: Book a club event in a configured venue without creating a scheduling conflict.
UC-GYM-003.trigger: Club Head initiates an event booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator/co-coordinator.

main_success_flow.text: The system identifies the actor's club.
Club Head enters the event name and identifies the Club Faculty Councillor/faculty context.
Club Head selects a configured venue and date.
Club Head enters start time, end time, poster, and description.
The system validates faculty context as applicable and validates the time range.
The system checks the requested slot against all existing sessions and events for the same venue/date.
The system creates the event when no conflict exists.
The system notifies the intended student recipients.
The system confirms the booking.

alternative_flows.text: If the slot overlaps an existing session or event, the system rejects the booking and asks the actor to select another slot.

exception_flows.text: If the venue, faculty reference, or time range is invalid, or the event cannot be stored, no successful event booking is recorded.

UC-GYM-003.success_postcondition: Event is stored and student notification is initiated.
UC-GYM-003.failure_minimal_guarantee: No conflicting or invalid event is accepted.
UC-GYM-003.flow_label_note: ALT-n / EXC-n labels are assigned in order for referencing; they are not source IDs.

preconditions: Selected club exists and is confirmed.

main_success_flow.text: The system displays/selects available confirmed clubs.
Student selects a club.
Student enters achievements or application description.
The system identifies the authenticated student.
The system verifies that the student does not already have a duplicate application to the same club.
The system records the application with status open.
The system confirms submission.

alternative_flows.text: The student may apply to another different club even when other applications exist.

exception_flows.text: If a duplicate same-club application is detected, the system rejects the duplicate and leaves the existing application unchanged.

UC-GYM-004.success_postcondition: A new open membership application exists for the selected club.
UC-GYM-004.failure_minimal_guarantee: No duplicate same-club application is created.
UC-GYM-004.flow_label_note: ALT-n / EXC-n labels are assigned in order for referencing; they are not source IDs.

One or more open applications exist for the club.

main_success_flow.text: The system displays pending applications for the actor's club.

The system validates the application and actor authorization.
The system changes the application status from open to confirmed and stores the remarks.
The system confirms successful approval.

alternative_flows.text: Club Head may approve multiple selected pending applications in one interaction; each application is evaluated independently.

exception_flows.text: If an application is no longer open or does not belong to the actor's club, it is not changed.

BR-GYM-001.name: Valid Student Leadership
BR-GYM-001.description: Club coordinator, co-coordinator, and replacement leaders must reference valid students.
BR-GYM-001.condition_trigger: Whenever a student leadership assignment is made
BR-GYM-001.required_outcome: Reject/stop the operation if the selected leader is not a valid student.
BR-GYM-001.source_rationale: Corrected PS + prior BR001 + accepted baseline

BR-GYM-002.name: Valid Club Faculty Councillor
BR-GYM-002.description: A Club Faculty Councillor used by the module must reference a valid faculty member.
BR-GYM-002.condition_trigger: Whenever a faculty councillor is assigned/used
BR-GYM-002.required_outcome: Reject/stop the operation if the selected faculty member is invalid.

BR-GYM-003.name: Allowed Club Categories
BR-GYM-003.description: Club category is limited to Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
BR-GYM-003.required_outcome: Accept only the allowed category values.

BR-GYM-004.name: Club Confirmation Lifecycle
BR-GYM-004.description: A new club is open; Student Admin approval changes an open club to confirmed.
BR-GYM-004.required_outcome: Creation results in open; successful approval results in confirmed.
BR-GYM-004.exceptions: No rejection transition is specified in the current baseline.

BR-GYM-005.name: Valid Booking Time Range
BR-GYM-005.description: A session/event start time must be earlier than its end time.
BR-GYM-005.required_outcome: Reject the booking if start time is not before end time.

BR-GYM-006.name: Cross-Type Venue Exclusivity
BR-GYM-006.description: No session or event may overlap any existing session or event in the same venue on the same date.
BR-GYM-006.required_outcome: Reject any session-session, event-event, or session-event overlap.
BR-GYM-006.source_rationale: Accepted user clarification; corrected PS; prior BR003 strengthened

BR-GYM-007.name: Membership Requires Confirmed Club
BR-GYM-007.description: A student may apply for membership only in a confirmed club.
BR-GYM-007.required_outcome: Permit application only when the selected club is confirmed.

BR-GYM-008.name: Multiple Different-Club Applications Allowed
BR-GYM-008.description: A student may apply to multiple different clubs.
BR-GYM-008.condition_trigger: When the student applies to another club
BR-GYM-008.required_outcome: Do not block an application solely because the student has an application/membership in a different club.
BR-GYM-008.exceptions: Duplicate same-club application is governed by BR-GYM-009.

BR-GYM-009.name: No Duplicate Same-Club Application
BR-GYM-009.description: A student may not submit a duplicate membership application to the same club.
BR-GYM-009.required_outcome: Reject the duplicate and leave membership state unchanged.
BR-GYM-009.exceptions: Applications to other clubs remain allowed.

BR-GYM-010.name: Club Head Authorization
BR-GYM-010.description: Only the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator may perform Club Head operations for that club.
BR-GYM-010.condition_trigger: Whenever a Club Head operation is invoked
BR-GYM-010.source_rationale: Prior BR007 generalized to accepted Club Head actor

BR-GYM-011.name: Membership Approval Transition
BR-GYM-011.description: Approving an open club-membership application changes its status to confirmed.
BR-GYM-011.required_outcome: Set the selected application from open to confirmed and retain optional remarks.
BR-GYM-011.exceptions: No reject/cancel transition is included in the current baseline.

BR-GYM-012.name: Minimum Poll Choices
BR-GYM-012.description: A voting poll must have at least two choices.
BR-GYM-012.required_outcome: Do not create a poll with fewer than two choices.

BR-GYM-013.name: Poll Targeting
BR-GYM-013.description: A poll is addressed only to the student groups selected by batch and branch.
BR-GYM-013.required_outcome: Determine the intended recipients from the selected batch/branch groups and use that audience for notification/access.
BR-GYM-013.exceptions: Branch selection may represent all branches where supported.

business_constraints_section_6: Club coordinator and co-coordinator assignments must refer to valid students.
The Club Faculty Councillor assignment must refer to a valid faculty member.
Club category is restricted to Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
A new club is initially open and becomes confirmed when approved by Student Admin.
A booking start time must precede its end time.
No session or event may overlap any other session or event in the same venue on the same date.
Membership applications are allowed only for confirmed clubs; a student may apply to multiple different clubs but not submit a duplicate application to the same club.
Only the applicable Club Head may approve pending membership applications for that club.
A voting poll must contain at least two choices, and a student may cast at most one vote per poll.
Club budget amounts must be non-negative and budget requests must include the required supporting file.
Club event reports must include the required report/details file.
in_scope_section_4_1: Club creation by Student Admin and approval/confirmation of an open club by Student Admin.

Membership application and approval only (apply + approve).
Voting poll creation, target-group selection, notification, and student voting.
Club budget-request submission and tracking only.
Club event-report submission and Club Faculty Councillor review/access.
out_of_scope_section_4_2: Membership rejection and membership cancellation/withdrawal functions.
Online approval or rejection of club budget requests and all fest-budget functions.
Generic administrative file tracking (handled outside this module).
External third-party integrations beyond existing shared authentication/notification services.
Mobile-specific interfaces, real-time chat, and event-attendance tracking.

UC-GYM-001.name: Create New Club
UC-GYM-001.trigger: Student Admin chooses to create a new Gymkhana club.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated and authorized.
Required student and faculty identity records are available.

main_success_flow.text: Student Admin enters the club name and description.
Student Admin selects an allowed club category.
Student Admin selects the coordinator and co-coordinator.
Student Admin selects the Club Faculty Councillor.
The system validates both student leaders and the faculty councillor.
The system creates the club with status open.
The system confirms successful creation.

alternative_flows.text: If any selected leader/faculty record is invalid, the system identifies the invalid assignment and allows correction without creating the club.

exception_flows.text: If required data cannot be stored, the club is not created and the system reports failure.

postconditions.success: A new club exists with open status.
postconditions.failure_minimal_guarantee: No partial club record is treated as a successfully created club.

UC-GYM-002.name: Book Club Session
UC-GYM-002.trigger: Club Head initiates a session booking.
preconditions: Actor is the applicable club coordinator/co-coordinator.

main_success_flow.text: The system identifies the actor's club.
Club Head selects a configured venue and date.
Club Head enters start time, end time, description, and optionally a poster.
The system validates the time range.
The system checks the requested slot against all existing sessions and events for the same venue/date.
The system creates the session when no conflict exists.
The system notifies the intended student recipients.
